name: Violation Nation
source: What kind of human being are you? - In the not so distant future, the World Council governs the planet, comprising of the richest countries on Earth. They start passing many new controversial policies including the highly contentious “Hwalchag Act”. Every year, 2 citizens from every country in the world are picked at random and taken away to the infamous, aptly nicknamed Violation Nation for anywhere between a few weeks to a few month
translation: 你是什​​么样的人？- 在不久的将来，由地球上最富有的国家组成的世界理事会统治着这个星球。他们开始通过许多新的有争议的政策，包括备受争议的“Hwalchag法案”。每年，世界上每个国家都会随机挑选2名公民，并被带到臭名昭著、绰号为“违规国家”的地方，为期几周到几个月不等。
